title: Shibby's Holiday Toy Giveaway! (ORIGINAL)
description: What better way to celebrate the 2025 holiday season than with toys! That is why I’m announcing a special toy giveaway in collaboration with my partners Lovense, Handy and Oxy-Products. Early in the year I ran a Haptics Competition that had so many fantastic submissions from the community. I know that not everyone is creatively minded though so this time around I wanted to make sure everyone had a chance to win something. That is why this giveaway is completely FREE to enter, no strings attached. Just a celebration to all my supporters and fans for being such loyal listeners over the years. Great, what can be won?! 5x Lovense toy of your choice 1x The Most Wanted Bundle 1x The Handy 1x The Oh 1x Shibby Chastity Training Kit 2x Classic Shibby Chastity Cage A special thank you to my amazing product partners for making this possible: Lovense Handy Oxy-Products They’re all running discount sales throughout November and December with up to 70% off during the holiday season so please check them out. Whether it’s vibrating toys with Lovense, having your cock milked by me while strapped into The Handy, or locking yourself away in my Oxy Chastity Cage… There are so many ways to enhance the experience of listening to my files. Oh, and remember to use my affiliate links for if you feel like treating yourself! Okay, but how do I enter? All you need to do is fill out the google form to apply. Don’t worry, it is just to indicate which prize you’d prefer and how best to contact you if you’re one of the winners. No unnecessary hoops to jump through. It takes less than 30 seconds. Must be 18 or over to enter. Prizes will be distributed on a first come first serve basis and may be subject to availability. Enter Giveaway! How long does it run for? The competition is open right away! It will be running from November 24th through to December 7th. Winners will be drawn at random as soon as the last day elapses so make sure to check your inboxes to see if you’ve won and be ready to give me shipping information so they arrive with you well before Christmas. Packaging is discrete and tracking information will be provided via email so you can keep tabs on it and avoid any surprises. Most importantly, I hope everyone has a lovely time over the holiday season whether you’re one of the winners or not. Best of luck!
author: Mistress Shibby
